product.name: Phone Case
product.subtitle: Shock-absorbing matte iPhone case
product.description: A slim, matte iPhone case with a soft-touch finish and raised edges that protect the screen and camera.
product.details: A flexible shock-absorbing shell with a soft-touch matte coating that resists fingerprints and grip-slip. Raised lips around the screen and camera keep both off the table, and the precise cut-outs leave every button and port easy to reach. Wireless-charging friendly, so it stays on the phone.
product.materials: Recycled TPU shell, soft-touch matte coating.

others.name: Studio Cap
others.subtitle: Six-panel embroidered cap
others.description: A clean six-panel cap in washed cotton twill with a low-profile crown and a small tonal logo embroidered on the front.
others.details: Cut from heavyweight brushed cotton twill that breaks in beautifully and holds its shape. The curved brim is pre-shaped, the crown sits low, and an antique-brass slider strap on the back dials in the fit. Subtle tonal embroidery keeps it understated enough to wear with anything.
others.materials: 100% brushed cotton twill, antique-brass adjustable strap.

others.name: Ribbed Beanie
others.subtitle: Cuffed merino-blend beanie
others.description: A soft ribbed beanie knitted from a merino blend, with a deep fold-up cuff that sits just right.
others.details: Knitted in a fine 2x2 rib from a merino-acrylic blend that stays warm without itching. The double-layer cuff can be worn folded for a snug skull fit or rolled down for more coverage. A wardrobe staple in a quiet, year-round palette.
others.dimensions: One size, stretches to fit most.

others.name: Everyday Tee
others.subtitle: Heavyweight organic cotton tee
others.description: A heavyweight organic cotton tee with a relaxed boxy cut and a ribbed crew neck that keeps its shape.
others.details: Built from 240gsm organic cotton with a dense, structured handfeel that drapes without clinging. The body is cut slightly boxy with dropped shoulders, and the collar is double-stitched so it won't go slack after washing. Garment-dyed for a soft, lived-in colour from day one.
